caption: The drawing depicts two main elements. At the top, there is a simple line drawing of a jar outlined in dark blue with two small handles, containing a decorative floral or abstract motif inside, also in blue. Below this, and occupying the majority of the lower part of the composition, a large, organic flower-like shape dominates the center, painted in varying shades of blue with soft, blended lines. This floral form features central circular shapes and elongated, curved leaf or petal-like extensions on either side, all rendered on a textured, brownish-tan rectangular background. The flower design closely resembles the decoration inside the jar, suggesting a study or enlargement of the same motif. The rest of the paper outside the brownish-tan rectangle is plain and off-white in color.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
